verdict.rationale: Aleph documents keeping existing financial models in sync with a single source of truth through pull/push spreadsheet sync, and it offers versioned forecasts. Together these suggest fresh actuals flow into existing models without rebuilding them. However, no evidence explicitly describes the forecast re-baselining on closed-period actuals after each close. missing for 10: explicit documentation of actuals-to-forecast re-baselining after close, detail on how forecast versions roll forward on new actuals, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the forecast re-baselines on fresh actuals after each close without rebuilding the model

citations.quote: Supercharge your existing reporting packages and financial models with a single source of truth that keeps everything in sync.
Bi-directional Excel and Google Sheets workflows, including pull/push sync, reporting automation, and drill-down.
Versioned forecasts, scenario modeling, and board-ready variance analysis.
